upgrade_rules.description: Composite action or reusable workflow inputs, secrets, or outputs changed; review the diff section and update caller workflows if needed.

sections.description: 3-6 high-signal bullets summarizing user-visible changes to Giskard's shared GitHub Actions and release-notes generator. Subset of What changed, not a superset. For features and improvements, explicitly state the caller workflow benefit; for bug fixes, state the resolved symptom directly.
New composite actions, inputs, CLI options, or capabilities for caller repositories. Each item must explicitly state the benefit to caller workflows.
Bug fixes in composite actions, Codex PR review, or release notes generation.
CI workflows, security hardening, runner environment, and dependency updates (not the dependency version table).
Caller workflow actions required when bumping the giskard-actions pin (input/output changes, required secrets/variables, breaking changes).
